Any authenticated mesh member can invoke any tool on any node, with full read/write/exec on the backend. The only prerequisite is the control plane URL (via Shodan, I currently found a few via a header, but since this project is still in its very early adoption stage it makes sense the numbers aren't big right now, it's got like 700 stars on GH). From there, the control plane hands over everything needed to join the mesh.
